text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—That concludes our agenda. Trainer,
is there anything else you would like to add?
choice_data_list: It's okay. Let's call it a day

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then that concludes
today's routine.
As planned, I shall return to the dorm early today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'll also be counting on you for tomorrow's early arrival.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Get plenty of rest today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...Tomorrow already.
I'll be departing for the Oka Sho――)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...That's right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It's so pretty......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I found these cherry blossoms while tending the flowerbeds
as part of my Beautification Committee duties,
and they've become a secret favorite of mine.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...The Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, Mother... after winning her debut race,
struggled to grasp another victory all the way from the Junior Class to early spring of the Classic Class――)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, through sheer tenacity she ran race after race,
earning the right to challenge the stage of splendid pinnacle...
the Triple Tiara.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(My debut race arrived. I wasn't... drawing any attention.
Even so!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Mother came so close to the crown!
With the fastest final burst, she fiercely chased the lead!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Falling just short by a single step, finishing in 3rd place.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... my mother's ferocious, unrelenting drive
has undeniably been passed down to me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(And now, the Oka Sho is right before my eyes.
To make my mother's scattered feelings bloom once more,
I've sprinted all the way here...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Though faint, though fleeting. Even if only for a single moment, I will engrave its dazzling splendor into everyone's hearts.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A run like that... I will definitely achieve it too—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Ah! I knew it, Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Did you come to see the cherry blossoms?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Could it be that you are too, Craft-san?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yep, we're matching!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The two of us.
...The Oka Sho is this weekend, after all."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Standing side by side with Craft-san, looking up at the cherry blossoms.
Just then, a gust of wind swept through, swirling countless petals into a vivid dance—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Clad in what seemed like a flurry of cherry blossoms,
she then looked straight into my eyes and spoke.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――I just love Tiara Umamusume so much.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Like passing a baton from one to the next,
I love every bit of the brilliance my senpais have carried on!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's why the bond between Messiah-san and her mother... is something I love so much too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...That is what you told me on the very day
we enrolled and met face-to-face in the same class.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's my dream!
Just like Messiah-san and Mom...
to carry on the destiny of the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's my admiration.
...I want to pass it on, too.
I want to leave "me" behind, I want to etch it into history!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That's why, even against you whom I admire so much, I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win the Oka Sho, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I think cherry blossoms suit you wonderfully,
Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fresh, vibrant, and lovely.
...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Who is truly most worthy of the "Cherry Blossom Crown"—
shall be proven out upon the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A glory you are permitted to challenge only once in your life.
The fierce and magnificent crown—
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The first battle, the Oka Sho.
We have finally reached the day itself—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As usual, Air Messiah quietly
finished changing and got ready for the race.
All that's left is to head to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So I thought this might be an unwanted meddling
in a sense, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be you are referring to
what we discussed before my debut race?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I'd love to.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then, could you lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we did before, I place my hands against hers,
and then we match our breathing.
Inhale slowly, exhale slowly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Visualize a small flame, slowly growing larger and larger.
Breathe in, breathe out, breathe in, breathe out—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I truly have... such a mundane
mentality, don't I?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if locking something away inside, Air Messiah clenched her fist tight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after carrying out the relaxation techniques...
her hands remained icy cold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After blurting that out, I quickly wracked my brain...
For now, I blow hot breath onto my hands and rub them vigorously!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rub it like crazy! Rub it like crazy!
...RUB IT LIKE CRAZYYYY!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?
Um—
choice_data_list: Alright, let's do it one more time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Flinging both arms wide open, thrusting them forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was only after that
I realized she was smiling."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Heh, ...fufufu, ...well then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...Ah, amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It's nice and warm, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! —So you've come.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We're finally settling this on a GⅠ stage,
Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...This is the serious match I have longed for.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Messiah!
How are you feeling? Pretty good, I hope?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No.
It was pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry!
Well now... that's wonderful to hear!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it our all today!
...With the first tiara on the line!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The heat fills every corner of my body. It should move properly now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —It's a match.
